root.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit Declined: Lamb Defense
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. e4 dxe4 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. f3 Nc6

overview: After 4.f3 Black ignores the pawn tension and plays 4...Nc6, the Lamb Defense, hitting d4. White recaptures with 5.fxe4 or pushes 5.d5, getting space and a centre and a quick lead against Black's pieces. Black's pieces are awkward and the game is tactical in the centre. Detail is thin and read from the moves.

white_ideas.idea: Recapture on e4 with fxe4 and push d5 to gain space
Develop Nf3, Bc4 or Bf4 and castle
Use the e4-d4 centre against the Black knights

typical_structures.structure: White e4-d4 centre against ...Nc6 with ...e5 breaks

character.notes: White has a centre and Black counters at once, so open play with tactics follows.

gambit.notes: Black declines the gambit, so the e4 pawn is recaptured and no material is given.

soundness.notes: Black's declining moves are playable and White is fine.

structure.notes: The centre is in tension until d5 or ...e5 settles it.

approach.notes: Part of the BDG family, which strong players seldom choose.

level.notes: Concrete tactics and a clear centre; the detail is not heavy.
